question: Who among the following eminent musicians was born in Bihar ?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ustad Bismillah Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bismillah Khan** was a legendary Indian musician known for his mastery of the **shehnai**, a traditional Indian wind instrument.
 
• He was born on **21 March 1916** in **Dumraon, Bihar**, India.
 
• Bismillah Khan is often referred to as the **"Shehnai Maestro"** and is credited with popularizing the shehnai as a classical instrument.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **2001**.
 
• Bismillah Khan's performances were known for their **emotional depth** and **technical brilliance**.
 
• He performed at the **Red Fort** on the eve of India's Independence in 1947, marking a significant moment in Indian history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar**__

 __
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shankar** was a renowned sitar virtuoso and composer, who played a significant role in popularizing Indian classical music worldwide.
 
• He was born in **Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh**, India.
 
• He collaborated with several Western musicians, including **George Harrison of The Beatles**.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma**__
 __
 
• **Pandit Shivkumar Sharma** is an Indian music composer and santoor player.
 
• He was born in **Jammu**, Jammu and Kashmir, India.
 
• He is credited with making the **santoor** a popular classical instrument.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain**__
 
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain** is a world-renowned tabla virtuoso.
 
• He was born in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**, India.
 
• He is known for his work in both Indian classical music and world music.
